permitDetails.facilityAddress: Technology Park Drive, at the Regional Business Technology Park, Lebanon, VA

complianceRequirements: The Caterpillar diesel-powered emergency generators shall not operate more than 500 hours per year each, calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.
Distillate oil consumed by the generators must meet ASTM D396-78 specifications for numbers 1 or 2 fuel oil, with a maximum sulfur content of 0.5 weight percent.
Emissions from each generator exhaust stack shall not exceed specified lbs/hr or tons/yr limits for SO2, NOx, CO, PM-10, and VOC.
Visible emissions shall not exceed 10% opacity except during startup, shutdown, and malfunction.
recordKeepingRequirements: Maintain records of annual hours of operation for each generator, calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.
Maintain all fuel supplier certifications for oil shipments purchased, indicating sulfur content per shipment.
Maintain records of emission data and operating parameters necessary to demonstrate compliance with permit.
Maintain maintenance schedules and records of all scheduled and non-scheduled maintenance for air pollution control equipment for five years.
Keep records of training of operators in proper operation of pollution control equipment, including names, dates, and nature of training.
Records must be kept on site for the most recent five years and be available for DEQ inspection.
notifications: Notify the Director, Southwest Regional Office, in writing, within 30 days after actual date of commencement of the addition of the new generator.
Notify the Director, Southwest Regional Office, in writing, within 15 days after actual start-up date of the new generator.

Notify the Director, Southwest Regional Office promptly, but no later than four daytime business hours, upon discovering a malfunction causing excess emissions for more than one hour; provide a written statement within two weeks.
Notify the Director, Southwest Regional Office, in writing, upon correction of malfunction and return to operation.
Notify the Director, Southwest Regional Office, of change of ownership within 30 days of transfer.
